name: What is the difference between an architect and a designer in remodel planning?
description: Architects handle structural design and permits, while designers focus on aesthetics and interior functionality.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an architect and a designer in remodel planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: An architect is typically responsible for the structural integrity and overall design of a building, often dealing with permits and complex structural changes. A designer, on the other hand, focuses more on aesthetics, functionality, and interior finishes. For many remodels, particularly those without major structural changes, a skilled designer may be sufficient. Some projects benefit from both.
acceptedAnswer.description: Architects handle structural design and permits, while designers focus on aesthetics and interior functionality.
